title: Audio Settings Panel
description: Cards in the panel that the gear of the status-bar audio pill opens.

toolbar.title: Audio settings panel cards
toolbar.description: Cards in the audio settings panel, after the audio card, in rank order. Other extensions add them through "jupyter.lab.toolbars" -> "AudioSettings" in their own settings schema. To hide a card, copy it to User Preferences and add "disabled": true.

disabled.title: Whether the card is ignored or not
